entity_id.description: ID from epim_search or epim_get, copied exactly (note_tab: the tab ID from epim_get)

data.description: Only the fields that change. task: {title, start, end, all_day, location, text, category, calendar, tags}. contact: {name, fields: {field name: value or null}, tags}. note: {title, tags}. note_tab: {name, text | append_text}. todo: {title, start, end, text, tags, todo_list, done}. Dates as in epim_create.
